text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Spike in 5xxs and tool-call timeouts on /v1/chat.generate (region: us-west-2). Current error rate 8% (baseline 0.3%). Paging oncall.
Jordan: got it, I'm taking this. confirming page -> I'm on my way to laptop. what's affected?
Sam: api errors correlate with high % of requests using tool/function calls and structured output. We see CPU hot threads on inference-01 and 02.
Jordan: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) throttle anonymous/guest tokens 2) temporarily disable tool/function invocation for non-enterprise customers 3) disable structured_output=true by default. Any objections?
Maya: thumbs on 1 and 3. For 2, need to check any active customers relying on tool-calls right now. @Eli from support, customer impact?
Eli: quick scan of active conversations: two SMB customers are using tool calls for internal bots (not paying enterprise). one support ticket flagged 45 min ago complaining about timeouts. no exec customers on tool-calls at the moment.
Ana: infra note: if we flip structured_output off we should avoid a full redeploy. We have a feature-flag gate we can toggle at the routing layer.
Jordan: perfect. I'll flip feature flags and apply rate limits. Doing the first step now: rate-limit guest tokens to 10r/s across inference cluster.
Sam: posting commands for audit log:
```
# rate limit guest tokens
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://internal-admin.redwood/v1/traffic_controls/rate_limits \
  -d '{"selector":"tier:guest","limit_rps":10}'
```
Jordan: executed. applying feature flag to restrict tool calls for non-enterprise: toggling `tool_calling.allowed_tiers` -> ["enterprise","internal"]
```
# toggle tool calling
POST /v1/flags
{
  "flag": "tool_calling.allowed_tiers",
  "value": ["enterprise","internal"]
}
```
deploy-bot: Flag change queued, targeting routing-layer (rollout 100% in 20s).
Jordan: rollout finished. seeing immediate drop in error-rate from 8% -> 3.2%
Maya: great. Now disable structured output default to avoid schema generation load. Ana to confirm no config drift.
Ana: toggled `structured_output.default=false` at edge. No restart required. trace sampling shows fewer KV cache loads.
Sam: monitoring dashboards: latency P95 down ~120ms, token CPU load reduced ~22% on the affected hosts.
Eli: proactively sent an update to affected tenants via support channels: "We applied temporary rate limits and disabled advanced function-calling for non-enterprise customers to stabilize the service. If you're experiencing degraded features, reply and we'll prioritize." Customers acknowledged.
Ryan: recording mitigation steps in incident doc and creating follow-up action items: rollback criteria, capacity plan, and schedule for gradual re-enable under canary.
Jordan: handoff time. Maya you're on for next 4 hours. I'll stay reachable for escalation.
Maya: taking it. summary: rate limit guest -> 10rps, tool-calls limited to enterprise/internal, structured_output default disabled. Monitoring for 1hr, then canary re-enable for low-traffic subset.
Jordan: one more: creating a short-lived Service Notice for status.redwood.com and posting in #general after approvals.
Sam: adding config diffs and the curl audit entries to the incident ticket (INC-2026-087).
Maya: noted. keep alerts muted for known noisy metrics; only escalate if error-rate > 4.5% for 5m.
Eli: support will update customers in 30 mins or on request. please ping if we re-enable tool-calls for any tenant.
Jordan: thanks team. leaving thread, available via DMs. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Incident flag: mitigation applied. Monitoring until 2026-03-15T03:45:00Z.
